scope: All 58 published reading pages: context-reviewed mathematical notation, normal named functions, complete scripts and retained monospace program text. Auxiliary pages are checked during rendering.
limitations: Automated rendering covers all published HTML in Chromium at 1440px and 390px, plus no-script 390px. Detailed visual review covers 16 representative screenshots; no Safari, Firefox, physical handset or screen-reader execution is claimed.

Presentation changes are reviewed against existing mathematical explanations, exact replacement ledgers and protected semantic references. This task does not claim a new page-by-page audit of every original-book proof or fresh execution of all example programs.
All 1149 preformatted programs, 138 scripts, 490 SVGs, 17852 IDs and 8865 links are preserved byte-for-byte or as ordered inventories.
Publisher failure/recovery tests are reused from I047 after verification of 29 unchanged inputs. The new archive receives fresh local HTTPS, server and public checks.
reviewed_cases: Group Explorer frf, fr and rf are variable products in MathML, with code retaining monospace.
Named functions log, ln, sin, Var and algebraic named maps are explicitly normal; variable products retain individual italic glyphs.
Scripts attach to real bases: BR squared has the power on R; p to a_p, r to u^j k and alpha_h squared retain nested indices/exponents.
Stochastic indexed sequences, hedging terms, expectations and 6 malformed TeX inequality commands are normalized against their surrounding explanations.
Source quotations retain original copy spelling, with newly structured mathematical presentation.
Program registers, mnemonics and identifiers in exposition use inline code; constant identifiers embedded in mathematical conditions use explicit monospace mtext.
